title: Gauge loan across shifts

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: The press team lent us this gap gauge until the end of our shift. I checked the first tray. The one with the green clip still needs checking.
turns.zh: 沖床組把這支間隙量規借給我們，用到本班結束。我已經檢查第一個托盤。有綠色夾子的那盤還沒檢查。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I can check that tray when my shift starts. Is the gauge at the bench mine to use?
turns.zh: 我上班後可以檢查那一盤。工作臺上的量規可以留給我用嗎？

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: No, they need it back before we leave. Our own gauge is at the tool desk. You can collect it, but bring the job card so they issue the right size.
turns.zh: 不能，我們下班前他們就要收回。我們自己的量規在工具櫃檯。你可以去領，但記得帶工單卡，他們才會發對尺寸。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Got it. I’ll leave the borrowed one here for you to return, then take the card to the desk.
turns.zh: 了解。我把借來那支留在這裡給你歸還，再帶工單卡去工具櫃檯。
